Example WithinHostExperiment dataset

Source: R/data.R
example_whe.Rd

A small synthetic WithinHostExperiment with 3 samples (donor, recipient, independent) containing iSNV data at positions 33 to 945 of a synthetic genome segment. The donor and recipient form a transmission pair (pair_id = "pair_1").

Usage

data(example_whe)

Format

A WithinHostExperiment with 28 variant sites and 3 samples. Assays: altFreq, totalDepth, refCount, altCount, qcPass. The length of the segment, 1000 bases, is recorded in seqlengths() from test_ref.fa.

Source

Synthetic. Built by inst/scripts/save_example_data.R from test_donor.vcf, test_recipient.vcf and test_independent.vcf in inst/extdata, read with readWithinHost.

Examples

data(example_whe)
example_whe
#> WithinHostExperiment with 28 variant sites and 3 samples
#>   assays(5): altFreq, totalDepth, refCount, altCount, qcPass
#>   qcLog: 0 filtering step(s)
#>   transmission pairs: 1 
transmissionPairs(example_whe)
#> DataFrame with 1 row and 3 columns
#>         donor   recipient     pair_id
#>   <character> <character> <character>
#> 1       donor   recipient      pair_1
